aspect: Lifts do not run without power
description: A wheelchair user on the fifth floor of a building with intermittent electricity is housebound on an unpredictable schedule set by the grid.
energy_note: Your front door opens when the power says so.

aspect: Rehabilitation services are the first to close and the last to reopen
description: Physiotherapy, occupational therapy and prosthetics are classified as non-urgent during a conflict and are not restored quickly afterwards, which is precisely when the recoverable window for function closes.
energy_note: The therapy arrives after it would have worked.

aspect: Rubble is a mobility barrier for a decade
description: Cleared roads are not accessible roads. Broken pavements, missing kerb cuts and rebuilt buildings without lifts persist long after reconstruction is declared complete.
energy_note: A city rebuilt, and still not walkable to you.
